---
title: Table heat and filter
---

```table
data:
  inline:
    - { a: 1, b: '"><script>HOSTILE_CELL()</script>' }
    - { a: 2, b: 'x" style="background:url(javascript:HOSTILE_STYLE())' }
columns:
  - { key: a, label: A, heat: '100%;background:url(javascript:HOSTILE_HEAT())' }
  - { key: b, label: B, heat: '"><script>HOSTILE_HEAT_TEXT()</script>' }
heat_scale: '"><script>HOSTILE_SCALE()</script>'
filter: '"><input onfocus=HOSTILE_FILTER() autofocus>'
sortable: '"><script>HOSTILE_SORTABLE()</script>'
```

```table
data:
  inline:
    - { a: 1, b: 'x" style="--rv-heat:100%' }
    - { a: 2, b: '<td class="rv-heat" style="--rv-heat:100%">' }
columns:
  - { key: a, heat: true }
  - { key: b, heat: diverging }
filter: true
```
